RETURN CONDITION FIRED: brief_lint.py over the real briefs now reports 7 PASS, 1 FAIL -- harness-v2-g-gates.md itself (line 92): 'says 14, lists 6, expects 10/10'. Root cause: line 92 is the Tests section's own item 4, whose prose nests double backticks to quote a backtick-quoted example. BACKTICK_RE (single-pair) strips only the outer pair, leaving 'fourteen checks' exposed as literal text, which independently matches STATED_COUNT_RE. That spurious second stated line finds the next list start at item 5 and counts items 5-10 (6, not the section's true 10) against the real 'PASS G 10/10' Last line. Reproducible, hand-derived before touching brief_lint.py; the same code matches all four of the brief's own specified fixtures exactly (item 2). Not edited: the brief is the main session's.

Interpreted three ambiguous points in G1, each verified against the brief's own four worked examples before finalizing: (a) rule 3 (stated line itself has 'Last line') fires only as a fallback after rule 2's lookahead finds nothing, since rule 2 is listed first and 'no numbers taken yet' implies a prior attempt; (b) 'up to 3 lines from there' (after a list ends) starts AT the list-ending line itself, not after -- needed for the counted-brief fixture's Last-line marker, which sits right after the final item, to ever be found; (c) the count check scans every line independently for a stated-count trigger, no cross-line 'already consumed' skipping -- the literal reading of rule 1, consistent with every other brief_lint.py rule accumulating one reason per independent finding, and exactly what surfaces the g-gates.md self-reference.
